'''Green Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the fifth member of [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Green Five.

==History==
[[Habeer Zignean]] used the call sign during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation of Hoth]].<ref name="SWI146" />

After the Battle of Hoth, [[Olin Garn]] flew an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] as Green Five in the [[Battle of Hospital]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

Years later, [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kell Tainer]] flew as Green Five during a simulation exercise to qualify for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Wraith Squadron|new squadron]].<ref name="XWWS" />
